'''Takeshi Tsuruno''' (Japanese: '''つるの剛士''' ''Tsuruno Takeshi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}, as well as a singer and on screen actor. He was born on May 26, 1975 in the {{wp|Moji-ku, Kitakyūshū|Moji-ku}}, {{wp|Kitakyushu}}, {{wp|Fukuoka Prefecture}}.
